note: Major Star Citizen events. confirmed = dates announced by RSI. expected = a yearly event whose dates are not announced yet; the dates follow its usual timing.

events.name: IAE 2956
events.about: Intergalactic Aerospace Expo at the Tobin Expo Center in New Babbage, microTech. Free to play for the whole show, with 200+ ships and vehicles to try. A different manufacturer each day.

events.name: IAE Best in Show
events.about: Best in Show day at IAE 2956.

events.name: IAE Finale
events.about: Every IAE ship and vehicle is out to try at once. The best days for free rentals.

events.name: Luminalia 2956
events.about: The winter festival of lights, shared by humans and the Banu. Usually starts mid-December with daily gifts and holiday missions. Luminalia day itself is December 22.

events.name: Luminalia day
events.about: Luminalia is celebrated every year on December 22 in the game's lore.

events.name: Daymar Rally 2957
events.about: The yearly endurance race across Daymar, run by ATMO Esports with a live broadcast. Usually late January; sign-ups open in December.

events.name: Red Festival 2957
events.about: Lunar New Year in the 'verse: red envelopes and festival rewards. Lunar New Year 2027 is February 6.

events.name: Coramor 2957
events.about: The 'verse's Valentine's festival, held every year on February 11. Last year it came with the year's first Free Fly.
